thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - multiple inference nodes reporting CUDA illegal memory access + misaligned address OOPS. Affected service: inference-svc-prod. Start=2881234567. Initial spike in OOMs and container restarts across three nodes in us-east-1. Paging team auto-page to oncall
Oncall Dispatch: pinging oncall, please ack and triage (paging via phone and slack).
Matt R.: acked. I'm pulling up metrics. Seeing eviction spikes and device faults on gpunode-12, gpunode-17, gpunode-21.
Sara N.: I see repeated dmesg lines for illegal device address on gpunode-17. Suspect kernel pagewalk race.
Raj P.: can you paste dmesg? Also any coredumps?
Sara N.: pasted minimal tail of dmesg:```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (0000:04): 79, PID=24567, GPU:0: Ch 1234, Fault: Illegal Address
[ 12345.679012] kworker/3:1: kernel: show_stack+0x2a/0x50
[ 12345.679123] kernel BUG at drivers/gpu/nv/nv.c:1234!
```
Matt R.: thanks. Containers on those nodes are restarting due to SIGSEGV in runtime. Pod logs show cuda illegal memory access at sampler stage.
Emily Z.: quick mitigation proposal: cordon + drain gpunode-17, move traffic via routing policy to capacity tier and enable model-fallback to cpu-quantized-1 for affected customers to keep latency bounded.
Raj P.: agree. Cordon/drain now? We risk evicting lots of pods, but node seems unstable.
Matt R.: doing cordon and drain of gpunode-17 now: ```kubectl cordon gpunode-17 && kubectl drain gpunode-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force```
Oncall Dispatch: :eyes: cordon started. ETA for drain ~2m.
Sara N.: while that's happening, can infra capture nvcrash logs and full kernel oops? If we can repro, kernel devs will need it. Recommend `sudo journalctl -k --since "10 minutes ago" > /tmp/kernlog.txt` and `gcore` of the runtime process if still alive.
Matt R.: nvcrash bundle uploaded to /artifacts/2881234567/nvcrash_gpunode-17.tar.gz. Also grabbed /var/log/kern.log and full dmesg.
Customer Ops: any customer impact yet? Which tenants hit fallback?
Emily Z.: two high-throughput customers experienced transient 5xxs while pods restarted. We auto-switched ~30% traffic to fallback models; degraded quality but no long-term failures. Notified Customer Success for both customers.
Raj P.: gpunode-12 and gpunode-21 show early signs - I'm going to pre-emptively cordon them next to avoid cascade. I'll do one at a time.
Matt R.: re-routing policy applied to route inference-svc-prod requests away from gpunode-{12,17,21}. Rolling restart for runtime on gpunode-21 succeeded with kernel parameter change (disabled a specific pagewalk optimization). Unknown if that will fully mitigate.
Sara N.: collecting stack traces from runtime:```
#0  0x7f1234abcd in gpu_mem_read+0x10 at gpu_mem.c:87
#1  0x7f1234bcde in kv_cache_lookup+0x3f
#2  0x7f1234cdef in attention_forward+0x1a2
```
Raj P.: looks like a race in KV cache access during concurrent eviction. Paging + eviction pattern likely hitting an unaligned pointer. We'll instrument to add extra checks and a safe-path fallback.
Oncall Dispatch: severity elevated to SEV1 given multi-node impact and customer 5xxs; paging team and kernel team looped in.
Emily Z.: next steps for live mitigation: 1) keep nodes cordoned 2) drain remaining suspicious nodes 3) maintain model-fallback routing and increase cache TTLs to reduce eviction pressure 4) snapshot nvcrash + metrics and handoff to kernel team for repro.
Matt R.: executing step 3 now: increased KV cache TTL in routing config and enabled prefix caching for common prompts.
Sara N.: in parallel, collecting reproducer. Adding additional guard in runtime to detect misaligned pointers and fail-safe to CPU path instead of crashing. Patch is small, can hotfix via canary.
Raj P.: please coordinate canary rollout to 5% of requests on dedicated capacity first. If stable for 30m, expand.
Customer Ops: notifying impacted customers now with status update - will include mitigation steps and ETA for fix.
Matt R.: canary launched to dedicated-5pct. Monitoring.
Oncall Dispatch: timeline update: cordoned 3 nodes, drain in progress/complete; model fallback active; customers notified. Keeping channel open for kernel dev handoff. :thumbsup:
Sara N.: attaching link to nvcrash + logs in case notes: s3://redwood-incidents/2881234567/nvcrash_gpunode-17.tar.gz. Kernel team requested reproducer steps and time window.
Raj P.: once kernel team confirms root cause (likely pagewalk race -> misaligned pointer), we'll schedule a kernel patch and a safe runtime guard. For now, mitigation: keep nodes cordoned and prefer fallback model.
Emily Z.: I'll prepare post-incident customer impact summary and send to CS and Legal.
Matt R.: last check - canary metrics stable for 12m, no new illegal address faults observed on canary nodes. Holding for 30m before promoting.
Oncall Dispatch: closing handoff to kernel and runtime teams. Leave channel open for updates. :white_check_mark:
